gen-gf-gabarito-gf-tirra: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its strokes running like thread stitched along a path. Tirra stays low beside it, a sans-serif of round forms that read like open parentheses.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-tomorrow: Traced as if by one nib, Gabarito has a single-weight outline feel. Tomorrow takes over below with bowls that open like a cupped palm of clay, clean and low-key.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-tuffy: One nib, plenty of swagger: Gabarito is expressive and distinctive, and loves being blown up for a word or two. But Tuffy, a sans sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, keeps its s widely parted.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-varela-round: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, open and expressive. Varela Round, a sans whose same-width strokes frame wide-mouthed lowercase rounds, makes the whole thing feel modern and clean.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-vazirmatn: Approachable and modern, this body text lets its s stay wide and never tighten. Vazirmatn does the quiet reading while Gabarito's flat, contrast-free letterforms are left to show off in big display lines.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-wix-madefor-text: Gabarito has a bent-paperclip look, its strokes never swelling or thinning. Wix Madefor Text keeps easy-to-read open terminals for the body, leaving the heading to stand out in large, expressive lines.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Gabarito's letterforms are flat and contrast-free, drawn as though with a single nib. Zalando Sans Expanded excels at a sparse, wide-gapped row of letters, while Gabarito is built for expressive display.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpa: Joints where strokes meet without swelling or thinning: that is Gabarito, expressive and distinctive. Then Zalando Sans SemiExpanded supplies open-mouthed curves, a modern body that lets the heading do the talking.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Body text here varies gently, with thick strokes barely heavier than thin and no ink pooling in the turns. ZCOOL XiaoWei carries that softness while Gabarito's unit-width strokes hold the heading steady.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiq: Expressive one-nib energy: Gabarito looks drawn in a single sweep, with distinctive terminals cut open, ready to lead. Shrink it, or enlarge Zen Kaku Gothic Antique, and the order flips.
